newsitem.title: USA: Xilinx cuts prices on logic devices.
newsitem.headline: Xilinx cuts prices on logic devices.

text.p: Xilinx Inc on Monday said it is cutting prices for its line of XC7300 complex programmable logic devices four to eight cents per macrocell.
Price cuts reflect cost savings in Xilinx's manufacturing process, Xilinx said in a statement.

Reductions include the XC7336, which fell four cents to $1.50. The XC7354 was reduced five cents to $3.00. The XC7372 fell six cents to $4.50. The XC73108 dropped five cents to $6.00, and the XC73144 declined eight cents to $12.00.
The prices are based on 25,000-unit orders.
Xilinx shares were up 2-1/2 at 40 by mid-afternoon.
